DexcomHelp: Use the sensor wearer’s account. Enable sharing and add a follower in Dexcom.
LibreHelp: Use your LibreLinkUp account after accepting a sharing invitation.
NightscoutHelp: Connect the Nightscout or Nocturne site that already receives your readings.
Who: Whose readings would you like to see?
TokenHint: Your access token or API secret
KeyringHelp: Credentials are stored separately for each provider in the system keychain.
WelcomeHint: Choose your provider to see readings here and in the floating window.
SecondaryUse: Use your sensor app for treatment decisions.
WidgetHint: See your glucose alongside your other apps.
TrayHint: Open the app from the system tray icon.
KeepRunning: Keep running when the window closes
BackgroundHint: Readings continue to sync in the background.
GuidesHint: These visual guides do not trigger alarms.
Unencrypted: The app does not encrypt the local file.
DeleteQuestion: Delete the {source} readings saved on this computer?
ReloadHint: Recent readings may return at the next sync.
DemoHint: Explore the app with simulated readings.
Protocols: Share and LibreLinkUp use unofficial protocols.
Schedule: Readings sync about every five minutes for Dexcom and every minute for other sources. Readings at least ten minutes old are marked as stale.
NoSource: No readings. Connect a source in settings.
ConnectHint: Connect a data source to receive readings.
HoverHelp: Move the pointer over the chart to inspect a reading.
NoData: No readings available from this source.
NoDataPeriod: No readings in the last {hours} h.
ServiceStopped: The sync service stopped. Restart the app.
ServiceStart: The sync service did not start.
CannotStartSync: Unable to start the sync service.
RefreshLimit: Refresh temporarily limited. Sync will resume automatically.
TrayUnavailable: System tray unavailable. Closing the window will quit the app.
AutoDenied: The system denied the change to automatic startup.
CreateDir: Unable to create the data folder.
TooLarge: The local file is too large.
Corrupt: Invalid local file. It has been kept for diagnostics.
Preserve: Unable to preserve the damaged configuration.
ClearSource: Unable to clear history for this source.
WriteError: Unable to write to local storage.
KeyringSave: The keychain refused to save the credentials. This connection will last for this session only.
KeyringRead: Keychain access denied. Sign in manually.
KeyringInvalid: Invalid keychain entry. Reconnect this source.
KeyringDelete: Failed to delete the credentials for this source.
AuthError: Sign-in failed. Check your account, password or token.
SessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.
TooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 30 minutes.
RetryNetwork: Connection interrupted. The app will retry automatically.
RetryProvider: Provider unavailable. The app will retry automatically.
InvalidResponse: Invalid provider response. No readings were added.
AcceptTerms: Open LibreLinkUp on your phone to accept the terms or finish signing in, then try again.
NoPerson: No shared accounts found. Accept a sharing invitation in LibreLinkUp, then try again.
ChoosePerson: Choose the person whose readings you want to see.
InvalidUrl: Invalid address. Enter the site's HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
AlreadyOpen: Easy Glucose is already open. Use its system tray icon.
UpdateFailed: Update failed. Check your connection and try again.
InvalidAudio: Choose a WAV file up to 60 seconds and 32 MiB.
AudioError: Unable to play the selected sound.
NotificationError: Unable to show the desktop notification.
